result.topic_en: Conclusion of a proof of Abel's limit theorem for power series: as r approaches 1, f(r) tends to the sum of the convergent series a_0 + a_1 + ..., with a note that Dirichlet told the author on 14 Sept 1852 that the theorem is due to Abel.
